capture: Isolated local headless Chrome, 1220 × 1240 CSS px, 2 device pixels per CSS pixel. Native unmodified application. Screenshots are lossless viewport-region captures, with no labels or data added. The amber pivot cell is the app's own pointer hover.

pathway_table.png.what_is_visible: All six filtered Papers, their titles, and the actual selected Pathway control.

pathway_search_header.png.what_is_visible: Selected Pathway and result count. Actual Table header controls.

mccrea_record_full.png.what_is_visible: McCrea record, its article DOI, tags, both linked pathway names, and the full curation and translation fields.

mccrea_record_identification.png.what_is_visible: Record title, source, DOI, Cat, Ia and Ib, and both pathway labels.

mccrea_notes.png.what_is_visible: The separately labeled curation, animal-study, and robot/simulation notes as stored in the app.

ib_cat_pivot_full.png.what_is_visible: Native Pivot controls and complete matrix, with the native hover state on Ib × Cat (21).

ib_cat_pivot_cell.png.what_is_visible: Actual pivot excerpt retaining the Afferent types and Animal heading, Cat column, Ib row, and 21.

ib_cat_drillthrough.png.what_is_visible: Table after clicking Ib × Cat, with 21 records, the drill-through tag and Back to pivot button.
